note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the rule text is supplied by the author, no rule is applied and no outcome is shown. Link kinds follow the supplied relationships only (plain relation = no arrow; causal only when supplied).

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Exploded view of the default example: four fictional facts, the written warning is recorded only in the earlier case (A). Rungs join the three shared rows, the gap row has none; the empty socket in B is related to the magnifier, which leads (sequence) to the stand holding the fact as supplied. The tracer runs rule → A → B → magnifier → stand; the magnifier is the focus element.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a tenancy example with five facts where the distinguishing fact (a phoned complaint) is recorded only in case B, so strip B stands first and the empty socket is in strip A. The author relates case A (not B) to the magnifier, uses a communication link from the magnifier to the stand, starts the tracer on case B and makes the stand the focus element.

rules: Rule Q (illustrative), as stated by the author for case A

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long fact texts, component labels, rule text, relation captions, issue and assumption to exercise wrapping and bounded shrinking in every layout.

facts.text: The buyer signed the standard order form at the counter of the shop
The goods were delivered to the buyer's warehouse on the third day
The seller sent a written warning about late payment before delivery
The full price was paid in cash to the seller's representative

rules: Rule R (illustrative text supplied by the author), as formulated in the earlier fictional case on its own facts
issues: Does the written warning make a difference for rule R in the new situation, or not?
assumptions: All facts are fictional; every other fact of the two situations is treated as equal

elements.label: Rule as supplied by the author (illustrative)
Magnifier comparing the two situations row by row
Fact recorded in only one of the two situations

relationships.label: stated on the facts of the earlier case
empty socket of the new situation compared
then lifted out onto the stand
